item.coloph: rje snang bzher lod po man chad nas/ rtogs ldan bsod nams tshul khrims yan chad kyis/ zhang zhung snyan rgyud gnad bsdus bcud dril man ngag yig chung 'di/ yi ger bkod pas 'gro rnams smin grol la 'khod par shog rtogs ldan kar tsha bsod nams blo gros la/ spa ston bstan rgyal bzang pos zhus/ ba'i bla ma drang srong nyi ma 'od zer gyis/ ldong btsun nyi ma rgyal mtshan bdag la gnang //
